repair.title: Home Fires Became Rarer
repair.summary: NFPA reports that U.S. reported home fires fell from 3.2 per thousand people in 1980 to 1.1 in 2023.
repair.why_it_matters: Building codes, alarms, safer products, and prevention work make everyday homes less deadly.
repair.caveat: Fire deaths still happen, and risk remains much higher where prevention is weak.
